prefix.description: Output file name. For AFNI format, provide prefix only, with no view+suffix needed. Filename for NIfTI format should have .nii attached.
prefix.title: Output filename prefix

jobs.description: Number of CPU cores for parallel processing
jobs.title: CPU cores

mrr_formula.description: Model formulation through multilevel smoothing splines
mrr_formula.title: Multilevel smoothing splines formulation

lme_formula.description: Specify the fixed effect components of the model
lme_formula.title: Linear mixed effect formula

random_effect.description: Specify the random effect components of the model
random_effect.title: Random effect formula

qvars.description: Identify quantitative variables (or covariates). The list with more than one variable has to be separated with comma without any other characters.
qvars.title: Quantitative variables

mask.description: Process voxels inside this mask only.
mask.title: Mask

bounds.description: Outlier removal bounds. Any values in the input data that are beyond the bounds will be removed and treated as missing.
bounds.title: Outlier removal bounds

prediction_table.description: Provide a data table so that predicted values could be generated for graphical illustration.
prediction_table.title: Prediction table

data_table.description: List the data structure with a header as the first line.
data_table.title: Data table

cio_flag.description: Use AFNI's C io functions, which is default.
cio_flag.title: C IO flag

dbg_args_flag.description: Enable R to save the parameters in a file called .3dMSS.dbg.AFNI.args for debugging.
dbg_args_flag.title: Debug args flag

if_name.description: Specify the column name that is designated for input files of effect estimate. Default is 'InputFile'.
if_name.title: Input file column name

sdiff_vars.description: Specify the factors for group comparisons.
sdiff_vars.title: Group comparison factors

vt_formula.description: Specify varying smoothing terms. Two components are required: the first one 'var' indicates the variable (e.g., subject) around which the smoothing will vary while the second component specifies the smoothing formulation.
vt_formula.title: Varying smoothing terms
